what: [observability] On the typed-allocator dispatch path (CENTRALIZED_ALLOCATOR, default OFF) a journal read failure is reported as reason=open_package_exists, not open_package_read_failed. Since 2926c22f3 the legacy src/runtime/strategy_monocle.py::_has_open_package_for_strategy fails closed by returning UNREADABLE_PACKAGE_PREFIX + <exc type> ('journal_unreadable:...'); pipeline._monocle_gate (used by the allocator path) treats any non-None return as an open package and emits open_package_exists with open_package_id='journal_unreadable:...'. The block is correct; the reason is wrong, so a read fault reads as ordinary anti-stacking. Fix: in _monocle_gate, map an id starting with UNREADABLE_PACKAGE_PREFIX to reason=open_package_read_failed (+ the same audit event). Unreachable in production today only because the allocator is default-off -- not verified whether CENTRALIZED_ALLOCATOR is set on the VM.
why_it_matters: A reason that collapses 'could not look' into 'looked and found a package' is the collapsed-state bug class CLAUDE.md names.
